Find the differential df for the function f(x,y)=ln⁡(x+y2).

a
dxx+y2+ydyx+y2
b
2dxx+y2−2dyx+y2
c
(x+y2)dx+(x+y2)dy

dxx+y2+2ydyx+y2
e
xdxx+y2+2ydyx+y2
